artifact_requirements.purpose: Identify the bounded source, owner and approved research-use scope.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: Source identity, owner, scope, timestamp, verification method and evidence reference must be available.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Document ownership, controller, processor and withdrawal authority relationships.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: Ownership relationships and responsible roles must be explicit and independently referenceable.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Define collection, transformation, annotation, research-use and revocation scope.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: Permission scope, issuer authority, effective period and revocation terms must be defined.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Record data inventory, sensitivity assessment, minimization and review outcome.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: The responsible privacy process must complete and accept the assessment.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Define purpose-bound lifecycle periods and expiry actions for every data class.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: All dataset entities and detached payloads must have approved lifecycle rules.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Demonstrate a controlled deletion and withdrawal test across storage and derived artifacts.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: A test record must cover primary storage, backups, derived artifacts and known limitations.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Document least-privilege roles, approval, review and revocation paths.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: The authorized access path and a denial or revocation test must be documented.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Bind exact schema versions, hashes, migration policy and change authority.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: Version, content hashes and change policy must be fixed and reproducible.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Bind a non-main validation sample to its approved source, permissions and split exclusion.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: The sample manifest must pass source, permission, leakage and main-split exclusion checks.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Bind the approved codebook, instructions, adjudication owner and agreement plan.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: The codebook and reviewer process must be version-fixed and accepted by the responsible process.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Fix the isolated pilot environment, dependencies, allowlisted assets and reproduction procedure.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: The environment digest and controlled reproduction test must be independently checkable.

artifact_requirements.purpose: Bind tested sandbox, network denial, stop authority, rollback and separately scoped execution approval.
artifact_requirements.verification_rule: Safety controls must be tested and the responsible process must accept a scoped approval only after critical prerequisites pass.

limitations: Every artifact status is MISSING and no evidence record exists.
Role names do not identify or appoint real people.
This plan does not select data, create privacy decisions, issue approvals, contact external parties, or authorize a pilot.
recommended_next_pr: Re-run SAEE Pilot Readiness Review after evidence artifacts exist
